text:
Maya (Finance): ping 1 INV-2025-0144 for StratoBeam bounced back (card charge declined) earlier this morning for $22,560. customer emailed about splitting payment.
Stripe Billing Bot: Charge failed for INV-2025-0144 (decline_code: insufficient_funds). Retry scheduled in 24h.
Ethan (AM): I chatted with Leo this AM; they had payroll timing issues. asked if we accept partial card now & remainder by ACH.
Leo (StratoBeam Finance): correct - would like to do 30% on card now ($6,768) and remainder as two ACH installments in March. can you provide invoice adjustment with payment schedule? no additional fees if they stick to plan.
Nora (Collections Lead): we can do 30% today, two installments next month. requirement: signed acceptance (email ok but I prefer a one-line acceptance with payment references). we'll waive one late fee as goodwill, not multiple.
Ben (Legal): email confirmation is fine for <$25k but add a sentence: "This agreement modifies payment timing for INV-2025-0144 only and does not waive future late fees for subsequent invoices." I'll paste wording.
Zoe (Support): heads-up they also flagged a rounding mismatch on the usage breakdown - we show 48.7k units vs their export 48,000. engineering already ran a quick reconcile; appears to be small rounding from per-request aggregates.
Maya (Finance): include a reconciliation line in the confirmation and attach the usage CSV we pulled. avoid surprises.
Ethan (AM): drafting email now. Proposed text: ```Hi Leo - we can accept 30% via card today and two ACH payments of $7,896 each on 2026-03-10 and 2026-03-24. Please reply "I accept" and include ACH reference when sent. Per our policy we will waive one late fee. By replying you accept these terms. Regards, Ethan```
Leo (StratoBeam Finance): replying: "I accept. Card payment initiated. Will post ACH refs when processed."
Stripe Billing Bot: Card payment attempted for $6,768 1 pending verification (3-5 business days for bank-level auth).
Nora (Collections Lead): hold escalation. if card fails to settle by 1768462000 (48h), we auto-retry or ask for another payment method.
Maya (Finance): I'll tag the invoice as PAYMENT_PLAN_PENDING and add WAIVED_ONE_LATE_FEE label when we get the acceptance email.
Ben (Legal): adding suggested sentence to thread - use exact wording to make it enforceable.
Ethan (AM): attaching usage CSV and short reconciliation note.
Zoe (Support): noted. I'm adding the rounding explanation in the email: "We found ~700 units difference due to aggregation rounding; total charge unchanged."
Leo (StratoBeam Finance): card cleared 1 shows as authorized, will update with bank ref after settlement.
Stripe Billing Bot: Payment authorization received; settlement pending.
Nora (Collections Lead): once authorization settles, mark plan active and suspend further dunning. Thanks everyone.
Maya (Finance): will follow up if settlement fails. closing thread for now but will reopen on exception. :white_check_mark:
